name: tightlip
description: Keeps secrets out of Claude's context: redacts keys, tokens and passwords in tool output, blocks credential dumps, and stops before an unredactable result reaches the model.

quiet.title: Quiet mode
quiet.description: Don't show a status line each time a value is redacted.

block_dotenv.title: Block .env reads
block_dotenv.description: Deny reading .env files instead of redacting their values. .env.example stays readable.

name_sessions.title: Name new sessions after their folder
name_sessions.description: Recommended. Without a name, Claude Code sends your first prompt to a small model to generate a session title, before hooks can block it.

allow_regex.title: Never redact (regex)
allow_regex.description: Values that fully match this regular expression are left as they are, e.g. known test fixtures. Leave empty for none.
